page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs using the x86_64 architecture, running on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with the instance scoring in the top 25% for multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. It demonstrates high throughput in parallelized workloads, such as multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. Single-core performance, measured via Geekbench and stress-ng single-core tests, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth and Redis SET operations also perform at average levels, while database operations and static web serving throughput register strong results.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio offer predictable performance for enterprise workloads without the overhead of hyperthreading, as the threads-per-core ratio is 1.0. However, the lack of local NVMe storage means all disk I/O must traverse the network, which may introduce latency compared to storage-optimized instances. This server is suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
